decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical device structures and constants.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
The file declares device headers, request headers, status and function constants and is included by BIOS, DOS and COMMAND modules.
The previously compared BIOS MSDIOCTL contribution matches all 1733 target IO.SYS bytes (review 011).
The prior DOS IOCTL comparison covers 735 bytes, with all 22 differing bytes in marked relocation fields (review 073).
The prior DOS DIRCALL comparison matches all 521 target bytes (review 055).
limitations: These comparisons support definitions exercised in the selected builds; they do not validate every declared device operation, optional build or final linked address. Complete core file identity remains unverified.
